roadmap_items: Integrate the board with live competitive-session data

coverage.live_board: Host-projected competitive-regional-world data renders into the read-only regional board with missing/unknown fallbacks.
coverage.facilities_and_reports: Visible facility components and written campaign/report surfaces retain source and fallback semantics.
coverage.project_progression: Active, delayed, and completed project overlays consume explicit actor-visible observation fields.
coverage.first_month_consequences: The host-connected seven-stage path exposes resolution, written effects, skip/review behavior, and refreshed observation handoffs.
coverage.planning_and_pressure_music: Planning, stable, pressure, policy, competitive, affiliation, and debrief states derive from visible inputs and retain written fallbacks.

authority_boundary: Host/core owns observations, transitions, history, replay, hashes, and visible music projections; the browser validates and renders supplied projections without hidden-state access or client simulation authority.
limits: This is current supported technical evidence, not full-campaign coverage.
It does not establish raster screenshot coverage, asset provenance, audio usefulness, accessibility quality, first-time-user comprehension, educational usability, or human approval.
The remaining vertical-slice asset provenance, evaluation, revision, and expansion decision gates stay open.
